findings.title: Out-of-bounds write in decode_value
findings.description: value_len is attacker controlled and unchecked, so the memcpy overruns the destination buffer.

findings.title: Use-after-free of the interned name
findings.description: The drop call frees the string and the following statement reads the same dangling pointer.

findings.title: Separator injection through the scope
findings.description: A scope carrying the separator makes the joined path ambiguous; the delimiter check is missing.
